sourceClaimMap.claim: A secured business loan uses an asset, such as property, as collateral. If repayments are not made, that asset can be at risk.
The Australian Government's business loan preparation guide says loans vary in costs and conditions, including the term, interest rate, setup costs and ongoing fees.

Business.gov.au identifies proof of identification, a business plan, financial reports (including cash-flow statements if available), financial forecasts, lease agreements, and personal financial information as possible application inputs.

credit-product advertising should give a balanced message about returns, features, benefits and risks.
